title: Annual leave
text: Full time is 40 hours over 5 days a week. Full-time employees get 25 days of paid leave a year, pro rata for part-time. Up to 5 unused days carry over to the next year and expire on 1 July. Leave requests go to your manager at least 2 weeks ahead.

title: Remote work
text: Office staff may work from home up to 2 days a week with their manager's agreement. Field technicians and control room staff are not eligible. The home-office allowance is 2 euro per remote day.

title: Expenses
text: Expenses are claimed in the HR portal within 30 days, with a receipt. Car travel for work is reimbursed at 0.23 euro per km. Meals during field shifts over 10 hours are reimbursed up to 15 euro.

title: On-call and overtime
text: On-call duty is paid at 3 euro an hour. Overtime is paid at 150 percent on weekdays and 200 percent on Sundays and public holidays, or taken as time off in lieu at the same rate.

title: Sick leave
text: Report sick to your manager before 9:00 on the first day. From the third consecutive day the company doctor contacts you. Salary is paid in full for the first year of illness.
